items.title: Model layer: add note storage to GroupState (max 10 lines, project-scoped), persist and restore it like the group name, and cover save/restore plus the 10-line cap with XGhosttyTests
items.blocked_reason: Implementation and tests are written (GroupState.note + normalizedNote cap, WorkspaceModel.setGroupNote, macos/Tests/Groups/GroupNoteTests.swift), but no verification command can run inside the autonomous session: the OS sandbox blocks both zig dependency fetch (network host deps.files.ghostty.org not allowlisted) and xcodebuild (XPC service connections and per-user temp/log writes denied). See Blocker B-001 / Recommendation R-001.
